text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. speaker: Doctor
text: That is very concerning; please disregard that previous advice as it does not match his symptoms. Can you confirm if he has heard voices or seen things that aren't there, and have you noticed any physical signs like fever or night sweats? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray, ESR, CRP.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia, likely with paranoid delusions and auditory hallucinations. The normal inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP) and lack of systemic symptoms make an infectious etiology like Tuberculosis highly unlikely. Given his age, the duration of symptoms (>1 month), and the presence of fixed delusions (NSA mind control, conspiracy) and functional decline, a primary psychotic disorder is the most appropriate diagnosis.
